text_block_list.text:
One day, Бива Хаяхидэ and I watch
Нарита Брайан
run in a scrimmage, whose
incredible performance
leaves me in
shock.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ sees her younger self in
my
stunned expression. She sees the
little girl who
was overwhelmed by her
sister's speed, panicked,
and got hurt.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She barely finishes her story when
Уиннинг Тикит
and Нарита Таисин, her
classmates and rivals, join
us.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
They're going to compete in the Hopeful
Stakes,
another junior G1 race. It looks
like Нарита Брайан
isn't the only tough
competition around.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
